consent.title: Discover the cuts that suit you best
consent.message: We'll analyze your face on your phone to suggest cuts. The photo is not uploaded or stored: we only send 4 measurements.

scan.title: Take a selfie
scan.tip1: Facing the camera, without sunglasses or a cap.
scan.tip2: In good light and with your hair off your forehead, if you can.
scan.tip3: Only your face in the photo.
scan.unavailable: Face analysis will arrive with the next version of the app.
scan.denied: We need the camera to analyze your face. Turn it on in your phone settings.
scan.noFace: We couldn't see your face well. Try facing the camera, with more light.

prefs.title: Anything else we should know?
prefs.optional: Everything is optional; it helps refine the suggestions.
prefs.location: We'll use your location only to show photos and barbers nearby. It isn't stored.

result.rememberConsent: I agree that Charles remembers my face shape to suggest cuts (I can delete it anytime).
